scope: All 130 accepted claims in the unfocused default live run whose candidate.source_unit is RESULTS.

method.population_rule: Accepted output claims only; candidate.source_unit exactly RESULTS. Output indices are zero-based positions in claims.
method.unit_of_judgment: Self-contained full proposition: actor, relation, target, polarity, modality, conditions, comparator, attribution, and cited source context. Methods, statistics, captions, and headings count if source-supported.

verdicts.incomplete_or_wrong_qualifier: Core proposition has missing or wrong material qualifier, scope, referent, comparison, or attribution.
verdicts.wrong_boundary_or_relation: Broken actor, relation, target, or clause boundary changes or destroys the proposition.
verdicts.unsupported: Independent proposition not established by the cited text.
verdicts.source_ambiguous: Source text itself conflicts materially or leaves adjudication genuinely uncertain.

method.criticality: major marks unsupported independent biological mechanisms or effects.
method.precision_policy: Conservative complete precision counts only complete_supported in the numerator; all other verdicts remain in the denominator. This is Codex-reviewed development evidence, not human heldout validation.
